blocks.en: There are two different ways of playing EVE:
blocks.zh: EVE 有两种不同的玩法：

en: You can play for free (i.e. without paying a monthly subscription fee), but you will be limited in which skills your character can train. This is referred to as "Alpha".
Paying a monthly subscription to play the game, which allows your character to learn every skill in the game. This is referred to as "Omega".
zh: 你可以免费游玩（即不支付月费），但角色能训练的技能会受到限制。这被称为“Alpha”。
支付月费游玩，角色可以学习游戏中的所有技能。这被称为“Omega”。

blocks.en: In-game this system is referred to as Clone States. Characters on Alpha accounts are referred to as "Alpha clones", and characters on Omega accounts are referred to as "Omega clones". If you pay for a subscription (paid for with time cards, monthly payments, PLEX...), your account (and all the characters on that account) receive "Omega" status until your subscription runs out (or you cancel it), at which point they revert back to "Alpha" status. There is no way to tell an Alpha from an Omega clone in-game. The conversion from Alpha to Omega is immediate, while the conversion from Omega to Alpha will always happen when you next log into the game.
blocks.zh: 在游戏中，这套系统被称为克隆状态（Clone States）。Alpha 账号上的角色被称为“Alpha 克隆”，Omega 账号上的角色被称为“Omega 克隆”。如果你付费订阅（通过时间卡、月付、伊甸币（PLEX）等方式支付），你的账号（以及该账号上的所有角色）就会获得“Omega”状态，直到订阅到期（或你取消订阅），届时会恢复为“Alpha”状态。在游戏中无法分辨一个人是 Alpha 还是 Omega 克隆。从 Alpha 转为 Omega 是即时生效的，而从 Omega 转为 Alpha 总是在你下一次登录游戏时生效。

blocks.en: If an Omega clone is downgraded to an Alpha clone (because the account's subscription has run out), any skills that character has trained which are not part of the Alpha skill set are locked and become inactive, i.e. they cannot be used, but the invested skill points will not be lost. Any items or ships which require the locked skill become inactive and cannot be used, and the skill training queue will be paused (but can be resumed by logging into the game). If the account's subscription is renewed, then the character is automatically upgraded back to an Omega clone and can once again use all the skills they have previously trained.
blocks.zh: 如果 Omega 克隆被降级为 Alpha 克隆（因为账号订阅到期），该角色已训练的、不属于 Alpha 技能范围的技能都会被锁定并失效，也就是说无法使用，但投入的技能点不会丢失。任何需要被锁定技能的物品或舰船都会失效而无法使用，技能队列也会暂停（但登录游戏后可以恢复）。如果账号续订，角色会自动升级回 Omega 克隆，并可以再次使用之前训练过的所有技能。

blocks.en: Alpha or Omega status is tied to your game account. If you have multiple accounts, then you can choose to pay for a subscription for some, all or none of them, and each account (and the characters on that account) will have the corresponding Alpha or Omega state.
blocks.zh: Alpha 或 Omega 状态与游戏账号绑定。如果你有多个账号，可以选择为其中部分、全部或都不付费订阅，每个账号（及其上的角色）会处于相应的 Alpha 或 Omega 状态。

blocks.en: Alpha clones are welcome to join EVE University
blocks.zh: 欢迎 Alpha 克隆加入 EVE University

blocks.en: Alpha clone
blocks.zh: Alpha 克隆

blocks.en: Compared with Omega characters, Alpha characters are limited in the following ways:
blocks.zh: 与 Omega 角色相比，Alpha 角色有以下限制：

en: They may only train certain skills
They may train for free up to a maximum of 5 million skill points.
They may add skill points to skills in the Alpha set up to 20.5 million skill points with skill injectors.
They take twice as long to train skills
They pay an additional 2% tax on any industry job (e.g. manufacturing or research)
They cannot accept any Level 4 or Level 5 missions from agents.
If you are logged into the game with an Alpha character you may not log in simultaneously (multibox) with any other character (on any account)
zh: 最多只能免费训练 500 万技能点。
可以通过技能注入器为 Alpha 范围内的技能增加技能点，最多可达 2050 万技能点。
训练技能所需时间是 Omega 的两倍
任何工业作业（例如制造或研究）都要额外支付 2% 的税
无法接受代理人的 4 级或 5 级任务。
如果你用 Alpha 角色登录游戏，就不能同时登录（多开）任何其他角色（无论在哪个账号上）

blocks.en: Arms Race Clone Skill Training
blocks.zh: Arms Race 克隆技能训练

blocks.en: Skills available to Alphas
blocks.zh: Alpha 可用的技能

blocks.en: The set of skills that Alpha characters may train limits them to:
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色可训练的技能范围将他们限制为：

en: Combat ships up to battleship size, as well as basic haulers.
Most Tech 2 modules are usable but not all.
"Navy" ships of Battleship size and below are usable, but not Tier 2 variants.
Battleship weapons, EWAR, most remote assistance modules, drones, harvesting modules, scanning modules and some others are limited to T1 and meta.
zh: 最大到战列舰级别的战斗舰船，以及基础运输舰。
可以使用大多数 T2 装备，但不是全部。
可以使用战列舰及以下级别的“海军”舰船，但不能使用二级（Tier 2）变体。
战列舰武器、电子战（EWAR）、大多数远程支援装备、无人机、采集装备、扫描装备以及其他一些装备仅限 T1 和 meta 级。

blocks.en: Expand the table below to see which skills you can train as an Alpha, and to what maximum level. For a list of skills you start the game with, see starting skills.
blocks.zh: 展开下表可以查看 Alpha 能训练哪些技能，以及最高能练到几级。游戏开始时拥有的技能列表请参阅初始技能。

blocks.en: Alpha skill point accumulation
blocks.zh: Alpha 技能点积累

blocks.en: Alpha clones can train up to 5 million skill points for free using the Skill Queue, as long as the skills are in the set outlined above. Beyond this 5M limit, they can continue gaining new skills from the Alpha set, but must do so by directly applying "Unallocated SP". In this way Alphas can gain up to 20 million SP worth of skills, which would mean training every Alpha skill to it's maximum rank.
blocks.zh: 只要技能在上述范围内，Alpha 克隆可以通过技能队列免费训练最多 500 万技能点。超过这 500 万上限后，他们仍可以继续获得 Alpha 范围内的新技能，但必须通过直接使用“未分配技能点”（Unallocated SP）来实现。通过这种方式，Alpha 最多可以获得价值 2000 万技能点的技能，也就是把每个 Alpha 技能都练到上限。

blocks.en: It's important to note that "Unallocated SP" count toward the 5 million limit for free training. This means that if an Alpha clone has 4M SP already trained in skills, and 500K SP of "Unallocated SP", they can only look forward to 500K more SP worth of free training, not 1M. This is vital to keep in mind if your goal is to get as many SP as possible into your Alpha for free.
blocks.zh: 需要特别注意的是，“未分配技能点”会计入免费训练的 500 万上限。这意味着，如果一个 Alpha 克隆已经有 400 万技能点训练在技能上，另有 50 万“未分配技能点”，那么他只能再免费训练 50 万技能点，而不是 100 万。如果你的目标是让 Alpha 免费获得尽可能多的技能点，一定要记住这一点。

blocks.en: If you wish to maximize the total amount of SP an Alpha can train for free, you should avoid any SP going into "Unallocated SP" until after you have already trained to the 5M limit. Specifically, this means that any non-expiring SP in your Redeem window or the AIR Career Program should be left there while you are training towards 5M. Redeeming them early means they eat into your free 5M, while redeeming them after will mean they contribute to your maximum potential of 20M SP as a free Alpha.
blocks.zh: 如果你想最大化 Alpha 能免费训练的技能点总量，就应该在练满 500 万上限之后再让技能点进入“未分配技能点”。具体来说，在你向 500 万训练期间，兑换（Redeem）窗口或 AIR 职业计划中不会过期的技能点都应该先放着不领。提前领取会占用你免费的 500 万额度，而之后再领取则会计入你作为免费 Alpha 最多 2000 万技能点的潜力中。

blocks.en: The same logic of course applies to Daily Alpha Injectors and any other form of skill injection. Because injectors apply points directly to "Unallocated SP", you should wait to reach your 5M limit of free training before using such items.
blocks.zh: 同样的道理当然也适用于每日 Alpha 注入器和其他任何形式的技能注入。由于注入器会把技能点直接加到“未分配技能点”中，你应该等练满 500 万免费训练上限之后再使用这类物品。

blocks.en: Unallocated SP gained by completing AIR Daily Goals can increase the total beyond 20M.
blocks.zh: 通过完成 AIR 每日目标获得的未分配技能点可以让总量超过 2000 万。

blocks.en: The total skill points listed on the character sheet includes unallocated skill points.
blocks.zh: 角色表上显示的总技能点包括未分配技能点。

blocks.en: Gameplay
blocks.zh: 玩法

blocks.en: While they are well suited for getting introduced to EVE Online, Alpha characters should be seen more as an "indefinite trial" rather than as a "free-to-play" option.
blocks.zh: 虽然 Alpha 角色非常适合用来入门 EVE Online，但应该把它看作一种“无限期试玩”，而不是“免费游戏”选项。

blocks.en: Combat
blocks.zh: 战斗

blocks.en: Alpha characters are perfectly viable in low-level PvP and PvE, and in support roles in larger-scale PvP (such as EWAR or tackle for a fleet). However, their performance will not be on par with Omega characters once the latter has trained the skills to start using Tech 2 modules and ships. Public fit libraries can help find ready-made fits an Alpha can fly, for example the Capsuleers.app fit library with its Alpha clone filter.
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色完全可以胜任低强度的 PvP 和 PvE，以及大规模 PvP 中的辅助角色（例如为舰队提供电子战或拦截）。不过，一旦 Omega 角色练出了使用 T2 装备和舰船的技能，Alpha 角色的表现就无法与之相比。公开的装配库可以帮你找到 Alpha 能驾驶的现成装配，例如带有 Alpha 克隆筛选功能的 Capsuleers.app 装配库。

blocks.en: Industry
blocks.zh: 工业

blocks.en: Alpha characters can mine (ore or gas) in a Venture or a Pioneer (but cannot use more advanced mining ships) and can perform basic (only Tech 1, no invention) manufacturing. While they will not be as efficient as an Omega character (who has access to more advanced ships and skills, which improve mining and manufacturing efficiency, and is not subject to the additional 2% tax levied on Alpha characters), they can nonetheless participate in basic industry. They can salvage wrecks, but they cannot, however, do Planetary Industry.
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色可以驾驶冲锋者级或开拓者级开采（矿石或气云）（但不能使用更高级的采矿舰船），也可以进行基础的制造（仅限 T1，不能发明）。虽然效率比不上 Omega 角色（Omega 可以使用更高级的舰船和技能来提高采矿和制造效率，而且不用缴纳 Alpha 角色额外的 2% 税），但他们仍然可以参与基础工业。他们可以打捞残骸，但无法进行行星开发。

blocks.en: Alpha characters can trade, but they will pay higher taxes on their transactions and have fewer options at their disposal (e.g. they can only sell items located within 5 jumps, whereas an Omega character has the option to train skills allowing them to sell items anywhere in the current region). Alphas can have 1 active contract at a time (i.e. they can create 1 contract, but have to wait for it to be fulfilled before creating another), but they can accept contracts.
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色可以进行交易，但交易时要缴纳更高的税，可用的选项也更少（例如他们只能出售 5 跳以内的物品，而 Omega 角色可以训练技能，在当前星域的任何地方出售物品）。Alpha 同时只能有 1 个进行中的合同（即只能创建 1 个合同，必须等它完成后才能再创建下一个），但可以接受合同。

blocks.en: Basic hauling is an option for Alpha characters as they have access to haulers.
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色可以使用运输舰，所以基础的运输也是一个选择。

blocks.en: Exploration
blocks.zh: 探索

blocks.en: Alpha characters can do basic exploration.
blocks.zh: Alpha 角色可以进行基础的探索。

blocks.en: Choice of race
blocks.zh: 种族选择

blocks.en: Alpha clones can train into any race's ship or weapon skills; they are not limited to training their own race's skills. In fact, Alpha clones of all races can train into the same Alpha skill set. However, the Alpha's starting racial skills count toward the free training skill limit while in Alpha clone state.
blocks.zh: Alpha 克隆可以训练任何种族的舰船或武器技能，并不局限于本种族的技能。事实上，所有种族的 Alpha 克隆可训练的 Alpha 技能范围都相同。不过，处于 Alpha 克隆状态时，Alpha 的初始种族技能会计入免费训练的技能点上限。

blocks.en: Omega clone
blocks.zh: Omega 克隆

blocks.en: Omega clones may use any skill, ship and item in the game. Additionally, you may log into the game with more than one account at a time (multiboxing), but only as long as allthe accounts being logged in have Omega status.
blocks.zh: Omega 克隆可以使用游戏中的任何技能、舰船和物品。此外，你可以同时登录多个账号（多开），但前提是所有登录的账号都处于 Omega 状态。
